page.layout: One printed page, title page. Title block centred at the top: author name, short title, subtitle lines, "Cum Indice." Below it a woodcut of a gateway, with a line of text across its top and vertical texts at its left and right sides. Printer's imprint centred at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword.

l.i: Addita sunt quaedam de eiusdem morbo

main_text.l: lata est porta & spatiosa via quae

page.notes: Woodcut: a gateway with a flame above and a wreath at upper left; the texts "lata est porta & spatiosa via quae" (top), "Introite per arctam portam, quoniam" (left, read bottom to top) and "abducit in exitium. Matth. 7.13." (right, read top to bottom) are set around it. Partly cut off at the very top edge are faint orange traces of a larger word (apparently "LIBR" with numerals) that belong to a different printed page or to show-through; left out. Handwritten cursive scribbles across the upper and middle parts of the page are not printed and are left out. The left-hand word "Introite" is partly obscured by the woodcut edge, so the reading of "portam" and "quoniam" is less certain.
